chunks: It has been revealed to us that punishment will befall him who denies and turns away.
ai.seo_question: Who is destined for divine punishment according to this verse?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Taa-Haa, this verse underscores the certainty of divine retribution for those who deny the message and turn away in arrogance, a theme central to the narrative of Prophet Muhammad's mission. Shia exegesis often highlights this as a warning against spiritual heedlessness (ghaflah), linking the fate of the disbelievers to their active rejection of truth rather than mere ignorance. It serves as a reassurance to the Prophet that the outcome of his da'wah is ultimately in God's hands.
